summary: Fusaka 于 04:49 在 epoch 411392 激活并最终确定，PeerDAS 上线；VitalikButerin 称这就是分片。Prysm 客户端随后出现主网问题。ACDE #225：EIP-7708、EIP-7778、EIP-7843、EIP-8024 与 EIP-8070 列为 Glamsterdam CFI；EIP-7819 SETDELEGATE、EIP-7932 次级签名算法与 EIP-8030 P256 交易被拒。

items.title: VitalikButerin：fusaka
items.note: 04:49；TimBeiko：Fusaka 已最终确定 05:07；VitalikButerin：Fusaka 的 PeerDAS 就是分片，节点无需看到全部数据即可就区块达成共识 05:15；raulvk：Fusaka 在 epoch 411392 激活，128 个列子网开始分发数据 07:02。
items.note_en: 04:49; TimBeiko: Fusaka has finalized, 05:07; VitalikButerin: PeerDAS in Fusaka is sharding, with consensus on blocks without any node seeing all the data, 05:15; raulvk: Fusaka kicked in at epoch 411392 and all 128 column subnets are distributing data, 07:02.

items.title: ACDE #225
items.note: 21:00，据 Ethereal news #1：Prysm 将发布修复并在下周给出事后分析；Glamsterdam 中 EIP-7708 ETH 转账日志、EIP-7778 无退款区块 gas 计算、EIP-7843 SLOTNUM、EIP-8024 SWAPN 等与 EIP-8070 稀疏 blob 池列为 CFI；EIP-7819 SETDELEGATE、EIP-7932 次级签名算法、EIP-8030 P256 交易、EIP-7619 Falcon512、EIP-6404 与 EIP-6466 等被拒；FOCIL 是否预先列为 SFI 交由 ACDC 决定。
items.note_en: 21:00, per Ethereal news #1: Prysm will ship a fix and a post mortem next week; for Glamsterdam, EIP-7708 ETH transfer logs, EIP-7778 block gas accounting without refunds, EIP-7843 SLOTNUM, EIP-8024 SWAPN and friends and EIP-8070 sparse blobpool are CFI; EIP-7819 SETDELEGATE, EIP-7932 secondary signature algorithms, EIP-8030 P256 transactions, EIP-7619 Falcon512, EIP-6404 and EIP-6466 are declined; ACDC will decide whether FOCIL is set SFI early.

summary_en: Fusaka activated at epoch 411392 at 04:49 and finalized, bringing PeerDAS; VitalikButerin called it sharding. Prysm then hit a mainnet issue. ACDE #225: EIP-7708, EIP-7778, EIP-7843, EIP-8024 and EIP-8070 are CFI for Glamsterdam; EIP-7819 SETDELEGATE, EIP-7932 secondary signature algorithms and EIP-8030 P256 transactions are declined.
